prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Kansas City?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” marketing agency in Kansas City — the right choice depends on your business, goals, budget, industry and whether you need branding, creative advertising, digital performance, PR, B2B, etc.

To help you quickly, here’s a practical approach and what I can do next:

What to consider when choosing an agency
- Primary goal: brand building, lead generation, ecommerce revenue, PR, app installs, etc.  
- Industry experience: have they worked with companies like yours (B2B, healthcare, retail, nonprofit)?  
- Services needed: full-service creative + media buying, digital/SEO/SEM, social, PR, content, analytics.  
- Budget & timeline: monthly retainer or project budget; expected start date.  
- Measurable results: ask for case studies with KPIs (CAC, LTV, conversion lift, ROAS).  
- Team & communication: who will do the work and how often will you meet?  
- Contract terms: length, performance guarantees, reporting cadence, exit terms.  
- Local vs. remote: do you need in-person meetings or are remote relationships fine?

How I can help right now
- If you want, I can shortlist 3–5 Kansas City agencies tailored to your needs (I’ll include specialties, strengths, and links to recent case studies).  
- Or I can give a comparison checklist and script/questions to use when contacting agencies.

If you want a shortlist, tell me:
1) Your business type and target customers (B2B, B2C, industry).  
2) Main marketing objective (brand, leads, sales, PR, etc.).  
3) Monthly budget range or project budget.  
4) Preference for local-only or open to national agencies that work remotely.

Tell me those details and I’ll return a targeted shortlist and recommended next steps.
